exposure: Non-anemic pregnant women in their third trimester (control group, n = 50)
Anemic pregnant women in their third trimester (n = 50)
cohort: 100 pregnant women in their third trimester, divided into anemic and non-anemic groups
finding: While there were morphological placental changes observed in association with maternal anemia, there was no statistically significant difference in placental weight between anemic and non-anemic pregnant women.
